question: Can I cast both halves of Alive // Well with fuse from my graveyard?

expected.shortAnswer: No: from any zone other than your hand, you can cast only one half or the other.
expected.answer: If you’re casting a split card with fuse from any zone other than your hand, you can’t cast both halves. You’ll only be able to cast one half or the other.
